items.title: Overnight sharp spell of rain drenches Hyderabad
items.text: Sharp overnight rainfall drenched Hyderabad, flooding areas like Hafeezpet and Kukatpally while IMD warned of continuing showers and cooler temps.

items.title: Last-minute train ticket cancellation costs Railways ₹25,000
items.text: Railways ordered to pay ₹25,000 compensation and ₹5,000 legal expenses after last-minute cancellation of a train ticket.

items.title: NCLAT clears ₹480 crore in Jet Airways employees’ dues, sets two-week deadline
items.text: The relief comes after a seven-year legal battle following the airline's grounding in 2019. In November 2024, the Supreme Court ordered its liquidation

items.title: India attracts $31 billion in climate equity funding, but capital remains concentrated in power, transport
items.text: Bridging this mismatch between project requirements and investor horizons will be critical to diversifying climate finance beyond power and transport and mobilising the investments needed for India’s long-term climate transition.

items.title: ACB arrests TGSPDCL engineer for accepting ₹60,000 bribe in Gadwal
items.text: ACB arrests TGSPDCL engineer in Gadwal for demanding and accepting ₹60,000 bribe to process ₹12.62 lakh bills.
